```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

resolve_appendix_dir <- function() {
  env <- Sys.getenv("DIAG_APPENDIX_DIR", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(env)) {
    return(normalizePath(env, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  }
  candidates <- unique(c(
    file.path(getwd(), "appendices"),
    normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
    normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  ))
  for (p in candidates) {
    if (dir.exists(p) && file.exists(file.path(p, "studies", "sma-2026.R"))) {
      return(normalizePath(p, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
    }
  }
  stop(
    "Could not find appendices directory. Set DIAG_APPENDIX_DIR or knit from 3diags/.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
appendix_dir <- resolve_appendix_dir()
source(file.path(appendix_dir, "R", "backtest-example.R"))
library(sstruth)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Goal

This is a **template back-test** you can copy for any stock:

1. **Tail-cut retrospectives** — re-fit SS3 with the last 0, 1, 5, 10, 20 … years removed
2. **Hindcast** — project with **reported catch** from each peel to the current assessment year
3. **Management** — from that end state, project **F = 0** and **F = FMSY** for `r params$management_years` years
4. **Collect** — one-step retro errors + forecast trajectories

Implemented in [`sstruth::ssBacktest()`](https://github.com/laurieKell/sstruth) and helpers in `appendices/R/backtest-example.R`.

## Configuration (generalise here)

```{r config}
cfg <- backtest_example_config(
  appendix_dir = appendix_dir,
  study_id = params$study_id,
  scenario_id = params$scenario_id
)
cfg$peel_years <- params$peel_years
cfg$management_years <- params$management_years

if (isTRUE(params$demo)) {
  cfg$study_id <- "sma-natl-demo"
  cfg$ss_base <- "C:/active/flr/sstruth/data/ss3/sma-natl"
  cfg$scenario_id <- "Scenario-2"
  cfg$run_dir <- resolve_scenario_dir(cfg$ss_base, cfg$scenario_id)
  cfg$scenario_label <- "Scenario-2 (demo)"
  cfg$peel_years <- c(0, 1, 5, 10)
  cfg$ss_exe <- file.path(cfg$ss_base, "ss3_win.exe")
}

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  setting = c(
    "Scenario", "Run directory", "Peel years (tail cut)",
    "Management horizon", "Retro folder", "Forecast folder"
  ),
  value = c(
    cfg$scenario_label,
    cfg$run_dir,
    paste(cfg$peel_years, collapse = ", "),
    as.character(cfg$management_years),
    cfg$retro_subdir,
    file.path(cfg$retro_subdir, "<peel>", cfg$backtest_subdir, "<scenario>")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
))
```

## Workflow

```text
run_dir/
  starter.ss, Report.sso          # full assessment
  retrospectives/
    retro0/                        # full fit (reference)
    retro-1/, retro-5/, ...        # tail-cut re-fits
    retro-5/backtest/                # management mode (new runs)
      catchReported/
      fZero/
      fMsy/
    retro-5/catchReported/           # appendix mode (legacy; collector finds both)
```

When forecasts already exist on disk, use **`--collect` only** (no SS3 run).

### Step 1 — Retrospectives (optional; needs SS3)

Skip if `retrospectives/` already exists with converged peels.

```r
run_backtest_retros(cfg)
# or: sstruth::ssBacktest(cfg$run_dir, peelYears = cfg$peel_years, runRetro = TRUE, runForecast = FALSE, collect = FALSE)
```

### Step 2 — Management projections (needs SS3; forecast-only)

```r
run_backtest_forecasts(cfg)
# or: sstruth::runBacktestProjectionsPeels(retroRoot = file.path(cfg$run_dir, "retrospectives"), ...)
```

### Step 3 — Collect tables

```{r run}
do_retro <- isTRUE(params$run_retro)
do_fcast <- isTRUE(params$run_forecast)
pre_collected <- file.path(backtest_output_root(cfg), "collected.rds")
if (
  isTRUE(params$demo) &&
  !do_retro && !do_fcast &&
  file.exists(pre_collected)
) {
  bt <- readRDS(pre_collected)
  message("Loaded pre-collected demo: ", pre_collected)
} else {
  bt <- run_backtest_example(
    cfg,
    run_retro = do_retro,
    run_forecast = do_fcast,
    collect = TRUE
  )
}
out_root <- bt$root
```

Collected outputs: `r out_root`

## Retrospective one-step errors

Relative error in catch and F at the one-step forecast horizon (peel `0` = full fit).

```{r retro-table}
if (!is.null(bt$retro) && !is.null(bt$retro$oneStep) && NROW(bt$retro$oneStep)) {
  knitr::kable(head(bt$retro$oneStep, 20))
} else {
  message("No retro one-step table. Run retros first, then --collect.")
}
```

## B-ratio at forecast horizon

```{r ratio-table}
if (!is.null(bt$retro) && !is.null(bt$retro$ratioHorizon) && NROW(bt$retro$ratioHorizon)) {
  knitr::kable(head(bt$retro$ratioHorizon, 12))
}
```

## Forecast trajectories (spawn bio)

```{r spawn-plot, fig.height = 7}
if (!is.null(bt$forecasts) && NROW(bt$forecasts$trajectories)) {
  df <- bt$forecasts$trajectories
  df <- df[df$era == "FORE", , drop = FALSE]
  ggplot(df, aes(x = year, y = spawn_bio, colour = forecast_scenario)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ peel, labeller = label_both, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Spawn bio after back-test —", cfg$scenario_label),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Spawn bio",
      colour = "Projection"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  message(
    "No forecast trajectories. Run: ",
    "Rscript appendices/R/run-backtest-example.R --run-forecast --collect"
  )
}
```

## CLI (copy for other stocks)

```bash
cd 3diags

# Collect only (retros already on disk)
Rscript appendices/R/run-backtest-example.R \
  --appendix-dir appendices \
  --scenario "Scenario_2/Scn02_base" \
  --peel-years 0,1,5,10,20 \
  --collect

# Full run (retros + forecasts + collect) — requires SS3_EXE
Rscript appendices/R/run-backtest-example.R \
  --appendix-dir appendices \
  --scenario "Scenario_2/Scn02_base" \
  --all

# Demo on local test data (sma-natl Scenario-2, retros exist)
Rscript appendices/R/run-backtest-example.R \
  --appendix-dir appendices \
  --demo --collect
```

### Environment variables

| Variable | Example |
|----------|---------|
| `DIAG_SS_BASE` | `P:/rfmo/iccat/2026/shark/Analysis/ss3` |
| `DIAG_BACKTEST_SCENARIO` | `Scenario_2/Scn02_base` |
| `DIAG_BACKTEST_PEEL_YEARS` | `0,1,5,10,20` |
| `DIAG_MANAGEMENT_YEARS` | `100` |
| `SS3_EXE` | path to `ss3` executable |

## Generalise to another stock

1. Copy `appendices/studies/_template.R` → `studies/my-stock.R` with `assessment_base` and scenario ids
2. Set `DIAG_STUDY=my-stock` and `DIAG_BACKTEST_SCENARIO=<relative/path>`
3. Run `--run-retro` once, then `--run-forecast --collect` (or `--all`)

Same pattern works from R:

```r
source("appendices/R/backtest-example.R")
cfg <- backtest_example_config(
  appendix_dir = "appendices",
  study_id = "sma-2026",
  scenario_id = "Scenario_2/Scn02_base",
  peel_years = c(0, 1, 5, 10, 20)
)
run_backtest_example(cfg, run_retro = FALSE, run_forecast = TRUE, collect = TRUE)
```
